answer.answer:
Here's the routing recommendation for your 8 hot leads — all drafted for manager review, nothing has been assigned yet:

- **Mike Rodriguez** (Enterprise, 62% capacity) — TechFlow Industries ($200K), Apex Solutions ($180K), DataCorp Analytics ($90K)
- **Sarah Kim** (Healthcare, 55% capacity) — Meridian Corp ($150K), Greenfield Health ($60K)
- **James Chen** (Manufacturing, 70% capacity) — Summit Technologies ($40K), Orion Manufacturing ($60K)
- **Lisa Park** (Mid-Market SaaS, 48% capacity) — FusionTech Labs ($20K)

All four AEs are under 80% capacity, matched by territory/industry expertise. Each gets a handoff package (BANT summary, booth notes, draft email).

This is a recommendation only — no leads are actually assigned in the CRM. Want me to set up SLA follow-up tracking next, or pull the full qualification report?
